title: Search Engineer
summary: Search engineers build and tune the search box of a product: they run engines such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or Solr and change how results are scored and ranked so people find what they want. They sit in a backend or discovery team and work with data scientists and product managers.
dailyDuties: Tune analyzers, synonyms and field boosts for better results
Build and maintain search and autocomplete APIs
Keep indices in sync with catalogue updates
Check click-through and no-result rates after each ranking change
Run A/B tests on new ranking models
Fix slow queries and cluster health issues

skills.expectation: Run Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or Solr indices, mappings and analyzers
Tune scoring, boosts and ranking and measure relevance
